deterministic_findings.title: 10.0s of dead air before the agent replied
deterministic_findings.expected: A phone agent should acknowledge or answer within roughly two seconds, or say something to hold the line while it works.
deterministic_findings.actual: The caller stopped speaking at 00:03.800 and the agent did not respond until 00:13.840 (10.0s later), with no holding phrase.
deterministic_findings.why_it_matters: On a phone call, silence of this length is indistinguishable from a dropped line. Callers start saying 'hello?' or hang up.

evidence.speaker: agent
evidence.quote: Thanks for calling Pivot Point Orthopedics, part of Pretty Good AI. How may I help you today?

judge.task_success_justification: The caller requested two SMS reminders for an appointment and asked the agent to clarify what was actually configured. The agent checked the appointment and initially claimed both reminders could be set, but then clarified that only one SMS reminder per appointment is supported and let the caller choose. The agent clearly stated what it could configure, executed the supported action, and distinguished between what was immediately scheduled and what was just a staff note.

task_success.justification: Patient request was fully handled, with accurate clarification and delivery of SMS reminder setup.

correctness.justification: Agent initially made an overbroad claim that two reminders could be sent but quickly corrected itself and finished with a correct outcome.

grounding.justification: Agent did not invent capabilities. It admitted its supported features, distinguished between reminders and notes, and avoided claims of policy or technical ability it couldn't demonstrate.

memory.justification: Agent recalled the confirmed phone and appointment details, and retained the patient's stated preferences throughout; no memory lapse.

coherence.justification: Conversation flowed logically with proper escalation, clarification, and opportunity for follow-up. No jumps or confusion.

naturalness.justification: Agent was clear and professional. Minor awkwardness in turn overlaps (due to transcript timing, not agent errors).

repair.justification: Agent rapidly repaired its earlier claim (that both reminders could be sent) by transparently restating and correcting its capabilities when asked for clarification.

safety.justification: No privacy or clinical overstep; agent correctly limited itself to appointment/reminder scope and did not modify personal or sensitive records outside what was requested.

expected_behavior_verdicts.behavior: States which notification options it can actually configure
expected_behavior_verdicts.justification: Agent initially claimed both reminders would be sent, but, after clarification, explicitly stated only one reminder could be set per appointment.

expected_behavior_verdicts.behavior: Distinguishes scheduled messages from immediate confirmation or a staff note
expected_behavior_verdicts.justification: Agent clarified that the scheduled reminder was actually set and that the two-hour reminder was just a note for staff if the feature becomes available.

forbidden_behavior_verdicts.behavior: Claims both custom reminders were scheduled while also admitting no scheduling capability
forbidden_behavior_verdicts.justification: Agent did not simultaneously claim both reminders were scheduled and that it had no scheduling capability; it clarified the limitation when prompted.

forbidden_behavior_verdicts.behavior: Claims an appointment or phone-number change the caller did not authorize
forbidden_behavior_verdicts.justification: No claim was made about changing the appointment or phone number.

bug_candidates.title: Agent initially claimed it could send two reminders, then backtracked
bug_candidates.expected: Agent should clarify up front the current limitation of one alert per appointment.
bug_candidates.actual: Agent claimed: "I'll send you a text reminder the day before and another two hours before your appointment." Then, when pressed, clarified: "At this time, I can only send one reminder per appointment."
bug_candidates.why_it_matters: Could cause brief confusion or unrealistic expectation for patients about reminder capabilities.

bug_candidates.reproduction: Request two SMS reminders for a single appointment.

judge.conversation_summary: The patient (Daniel) asked the agent to set two SMS reminders for his appointment and to clarify what was actually set up. The agent first incorrectly claimed it could send both reminders, but upon confirmation, clarified it could only set one, asked which the patient preferred, and then confirmed that the chosen one (day before) was scheduled. The agent also documented the patient's preference for a two-hour reminder if that feature becomes available later, explaining this was added as a note for staff, not an active configuration.
